title: Llull's ordered chamber tables as complete operational macros under one global code
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED: Ars brevis supplies an actual external concept alphabet, a T marker separating absolute from relative principles, and chambers that expand to finite families of propositions/questions. University of Siena ALIM resource181 preserves the authorial Latin rules; Othmer MS4 at Science History Institute, digitized by UPenn OPenn, preserves the alphabet and ordered tables. This is distinct from GDT891's vegetative-tree attribute problem. An operational chamber does not mean one unique sentence. Unordered combination membership leaves concept permutations; a literal ordered-table copying law is a separate stronger hypothesis. No Voynich target, image or fit was accessed.

design.mechanism: Use the ten written code letters B,C,D,E,F,G,H,I,K,T. Their interpretations come from the external source, not from fitted word meanings. In the table, letters before T use Figure A's absolute principles and letters after T use Figure T's relative principles. Preserve the actual witness serialization: the inspected Othmer7r top cells contain three letters, whereas marked cells contain four; do not silently append a T to the top cells. An unknown global injective prefix-free assignment of these ten letters to nonempty literal cipher strings of length1 or2 is an explicit cryptographic hypothesis, not an attested Llull cipher. One complete written target group must encode one entire source chamber without padding, omissions, per-entry keys or per-word expansions.
design.unit: A candidate complete record is one fully collated twenty-cell source column, preserving its exact cell order and boundaries. A complete table passage contains all seven columns in the independently observed order. Every record in the declared target domain must belong to complete such passages; no best matching window or unexplained residual is permitted. Whether any target domain genuinely has this record structure remains unestablished. This is a literal table-copy hypothesis, not the claim that every operational use of Llull's Art follows table order.
design.semantics: Keep chamber meaning as an externally bounded operation or set, not an invented unique Latin sentence. Ars brevis VI explicitly extracts twelve predications and twenty-four questions from BC. VII states thirty predications and ninety questions for a three-letter chamber. The definitions and application context constrain interpretation, and the source explicitly requires reasoning to resolve questions. T selects between the first two principle registers; it is not a documented arbitrary selector among all six alphabet columns. Do not invent a missing subject, polarity, question-type or individual referent code.
design.contrast: For unordered complete pair/triple families, any permutation of B..K preserves combination membership and can be absorbed into the unknown key. Literal canonical ordering can remove such automorphisms: Othmer4r contains the ordered adjacent pairs BC,CD,DE,EF,FG,GH,HI,IK in its top row. That constraint is available only under the declared literal serialization law. Source rigidity still does not establish a unique target embedding; retain every global key and complete assignment. GDT891 concerns owned vegetative captions/actions, GDT888 concerns named incidence with opaque bodies, and GDT893 concerns whole-word source windows. None establishes this chamber-code contract.
design.prediction: Only after a complete source collation and a separately fixed complete target passage are admitted, a prospective exact-copy test could withhold the entire fourth column while fitting the other six. The surrounding six source columns collectively contain all nine principle letters and T, so the source-side design need not require a new code value for the held column. Before reading its target content, every surviving key must predict the same full encoded held column. No key, chamber order, spelling or missing selector may be fitted on the held material. This predicts a conditional written operation register, not unique original wording or an independent manuscript meaning.

design.scope: Retain as a source-grounded raw operational-macro architecture only. It supplies no current target admission, source-copy evidence, English gloss, decipherment, or GDT388 pass. The full fourth-figure rotation language and its stated252 chambers are not certified merely by counting abstract combinations. No automatic fallback from GDT895 or from failed table-copying to arbitrary chamber subsets, reordered cells or unmarked semantic selectors. A concrete target contract and source/target capacity remain missing. Study budget35minutes, source only; no decoder construction.
